category: currency exchange rate API and central-bank rate datasets, keyless

free_tier.stated: No key and no account: the ECB reference table re-based to any of 30 currencies once a day, and the latest table of each central bank and tax authority; 120 requests a minute per IP address.
free_tier.notes: The ECB endpoint is /api/open/latest/{BASE}; the central-bank tables are /api/open/central-bank/{code}, with csv, xml and xlsx output. A table for a past date, a date range and the calendars need a key. A public page that shows the rates carries a visible link to AllRatesToday; back-end use needs no link. The keyless central-bank tables are for development, evaluation, personal projects and internal tooling. A machine caller may also issue itself a trial key with one POST: 100 lifetime calls, valid 7 days, no email and no captcha, 3 keys per IP address a day.

retention.stated: not applicable: a query API and a dataset with no stored objects

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the per-IP request rate bounds what a caller can pull

interface_detail: GET https://allratestoday.com/api/open/latest/USD returns JSON with CORS enabled; the central-bank tables and the GitHub dataset also give csv
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; a browser can call the ECB endpoint directly
chaining: Daily ECB reference rates for invoices and reports with no sign-up. For a bulk history, the GitHub dataset holds one CSV file per source and year.

limits.value: 120 requests a minute per IP address, then HTTP 429 with Retry-After
latest table only on the keyless endpoints; a past date or a range needs a key

limits_note: Currency coverage: 30 currencies in the ECB table. The site also lists a Hugging Face dataset and a Kaggle dataset.
binding_note: The 120 a minute per IP address bounds a burst, but the table changes once a day, so the daily refresh and the latest-only rule bind in practice.

identity_cost.detail: No key and no account for the open endpoints and the GitHub dataset. The agent trial key needs one POST with no email and no captcha.

reliability_note: Over the per-IP rate the endpoint answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After. The ECB table changes once a day, and the page asks for at most one request an hour per server.
confidence_note: Rate, coverage and licence are quoted from first-party pages. One keyless GET of the ECB endpoint answered HTTP 200 with the ECB table; the 429 cut-off was not measured.
